name: Hackdirt original Dar-Ma travel: fresh process from shop entry

files.content:
replace=config
replace=data
resources="{resources}"
data="{oblivion_data}"
content=Oblivion.esm
start=ChorrolNorthernGoodsAndTrade::ref=0x0280fa::side=south
skip-menu=1
new-game=0
no-grab=1
user-data="{output}/userdata"
data-local="{output}/test-data"
content=hackdirt-observer.omwscripts

[Video]
resolution x = 640
resolution y = 360
fullscreen = false
framerate limit = 60
[General]
screenshot format = png

[Input]
enable controller = true

[GUI]
controller menus = true

[Input]
camera sensitivity = 0.5

local self=require('openmw.self')
local core=require('openmw.core')
local util=require('openmw.util')
local camera=require('openmw.camera')
local nearby=require('openmw.nearby')
local Actor=require('openmw.types').Actor
local timer=0
local index=1
local points={{{{-64640,91990,14184}},{{-64731.38671875,92111.96875,14184.0}},{{-64752.3125,92300.265625,14184.0}},{{-65003.28125,92568.03125,14184.0}},{{-65307.5625,92539.8125,14184.0}},{{-65845.8984375,92421.2890625,14204.0}},{{-66193.796875,92548.71875,14184.0}},{{-66442.03125,92596.015625,14198.0}},{{-66717.390625,92723.578125,14298.0}}}}
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function(dt)
 timer=timer+dt;if timer<0.1 then return end;timer=0
 assert(not Actor.isDead(self),'Player died returning to shop')
 local a=nearby.getObjectByFormId(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x280fa))
 if a and a:isValid() then assert(not Actor.isDead(a),'Dar-Ma died returning to shop');print('ReturnShop darmaCell='..a.cell.name..' position='..tostring(a.position)..' health='..Actor.stats.dynamic.health(a).current) end
 if core.isWorldPaused() then print('ReturnShop paused');return end
 print('ReturnShop playerCell='..self.cell.name..' position='..tostring(self.position))
 if self.cell.name=='ChorrolNorthernGoodsAndTrade' then
  print('ReturnShop enteredShop');if a and a:isValid() and a.cell.name==self.cell.name then print('ReturnShop darmaArrived') end
  if a and a:isValid() and a.cell.isExterior and (a.position-self.position):length()<450 then print('ReturnShop followerExterior') end
  return
 end
 local tag,target
 if index<=#points then
  tag=tostring(index);local p=points[index];target=util.vector3(p[1],p[2],p[3]);local v=target-self.position
  if math.sqrt(v.x*v.x+v.y*v.y)<20 then print('ReturnShop reached='..tag);index=index+1;return end
 else
  tag='door';local door=nearby.getObjectByFormId(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x104a3));assert(door and door:isValid(),'Original Northern Goods shop door missing');target=door.position+util.vector3(0,0,30);print('ReturnShop doorDistance='..(target-self.position):length())
 end
 local v=target-self.position;local f=self.rotation:apply(util.vector3(0,1,0));local angle=math.atan2(f.y*v.x-f.x*v.y,f.x*v.x+f.y*v.y);local pitch=0
 if tag=='door' then local c=target-camera.getPosition();pitch=-math.atan2(c.z,math.sqrt(c.x*c.x+c.y*c.y)) end
 if math.abs(angle)<0.05 and math.abs(pitch-camera.getPitch())<0.04 then print('ReturnShop ready='..tag) end
 print(string.format('ReturnShop aim x=%d y=%d',math.max(-150,math.min(150,math.floor(angle*128+.5))),math.max(-100,math.min(100,math.floor((pitch-camera.getPitch())*128+.5)))))
end}}}}
